disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensing authorities may revoke a pawnbroker's license at their discretion.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: may revoke such licenses at pleasure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to retain pledged articles for the required period before sale.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any such pawnbroker who violates any provision of this or the preceding section shall be punished by a fine of not more than fifty dollars.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to admit an authorized officer to the premises or failing to exhibit articles, books, and inventories on demand.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensed pawnbroker, clerk, agent or other person in charge of such premises who refuses to admit thereto an officer authorized to enter the same, or who fails to exhibit to him on demand all such articles, books and inventories

disciplinary_grounds.description: Carrying on pawnbroker business without a license, or in a place or manner not designated in the license, or after license revocation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever, not being licensed, carries on such business or is concerned therein within such town, or, being licensed, carries on such business or is concerned therein in any other place or manner than that designated in his license or after notice to him that his license has been revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging or receiving a greater rate of interest than that fixed by the licensing authorities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no licensed pawnbroker shall charge or receive a greater rate of interest than that so fixed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of recordkeeping requirements including failure to maintain required books, furnish records, or photograph pledgers.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whoever violates any provision of the six preceding sections shall be punished by a fine of not less than fifty nor more than three hundred dollars or by imprisonment for not more than two months, or both.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of recordkeeping provisions regarding articles pawned that are found to be stolen.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any pawnbroker who violates the provisions of section seventy-nine in reference to articles pawned which are found to be stolen articles shall be liable for the loss incurred by the loan

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly writing the wrong name or address of a person offering a tool for sale or pawn, or knowingly permitting the signing of a wrong name or address.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any pawnbroker who knowingly writes the wrong name or address of a person thus offering a tool for sale or for pawn, or knowingly permits the signing of such wrong name or address, shall be fined one hundred dollars for the first offence, and upon a second offence his license shall be revoked
